plan.title: test(coverage): restore branches >= 85% (84.99% blocks v0.86.0 release Step 5)

narratives.Description: Release Step 5 fails because vitest branch coverage is 84.99% against the 85% global threshold. v0.85.0 already used --allow-coverage-debt, so this cut must restore real coverage rather than soft-pass again.
narratives.Overview: Hairline branch-coverage restore so v0.86.0 can clear Step 5 without consecutive coverage-debt soft-pass.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer cutting v0.86.0, I want task check branch coverage at or above 85%, so that the release Step 5 gate passes without --allow-coverage-debt.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Run the coverage lane and task coverage:hotspots. Add focused branch tests in packages/core/src/vitest-runner/ (coverage-debt*.ts / win32-coverage-tmp-setup) and other high-ROI near-miss modules identified by hotspots — same approach as #2836 / PR #2845. Confirm global branch coverage >= 85% via pnpm exec vitest run under the ts:check-lane coverage config. Update CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] citing #2865. Do not use --allow-coverage-debt and do not edit AGENTS.md.

items.title: Given the ts:check-lane coverage report, when the suite finishes on this branch, then global branch coverage is at least 85.00%.

narrative.Acceptance: Given master with this fix merged, when task check runs the coverage gate, then the report shows Coverage for branches >= 85% and the command exits 0 without --allow-coverage-debt.

items.title: Given CHANGELOG.md, when the PR opens, then [Unreleased] cites #2865.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the opened PR, when CHANGELOG [Unreleased] is read, then a Fixed or Changed bullet cites #2865.

items.title: Given the v0.86.0 cut resume, when Step 5 runs after merge, then --allow-coverage-debt is not required.

narrative.Acceptance: Given #2865 merged, when task release Step 5 re-runs, then it does not fail on the 84.99% hairline and does not need the debt hatch.
